For you, my Jani

My dearest Jani,

Happy birthday to the person who makes my world a little brighter just by being in it. I hope this new year of your life brings you peace, happiness, success, and all the beautiful things your heart has been wishing for.

I may not always have the perfect words, but I hope you never doubt how special you are to me. I am grateful for you, for your smile, for the memories we are making, and for all the little moments that are still waiting for us.

Today is all about you. So smile a little extra, enjoy your day, and remember that someone is cheering for you with her whole heart.

Always yours, ♡
